entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The 1772 Instrument of Government was the constitution of the Kingdom of Sweden from 1772 to 1809. It is also known as "Swedish-Finnish Constitution". It was promulgated well in advance of the Revolution of 1772 for greater division of powers, a self-coup mounted by King Gustav III, and replaced the 1720 Instrument of Government, which had been in force for most of the Age of Liberty (1719-72).
